title: SG-9 Replace the flat scene image with the Phaser host in the game screen
summary: The game screen renders the bedroom through PhaserHost instead of a flat image with hotspot buttons.
description: Context: App.tsx composes the game screen with SceneView, which shows one flat (ASSET_PATHS['scene:'+id]) with absolutely positioned HTML hotspot
acceptance_criteria: Given the player clicked Begin, when App renders the playing view, then PhaserHost is mounted with BootScene in its scenes prop and no SceneView image or hotspot button is rendered.
Given the playing view is mounted and App re-renders, when createGame calls are counted, then createGame was called exactly once and destroy(true) is called once on unmount.
Given Phaser emits objectClick for an object id, when App is rendered, then the ActionMenu opens for that object.
Given unit tests run, when Phaser and createGame are mocked, then no real Phaser game or canvas is created.

in_scope: Mount PhaserHost with BootScene in App's scene slot
Bridge the objectClick event from the typed bus to App selection state
out_of_scope: Changing BootScene, buildScene or the layer engine
Deleting the SceneView component or its tests
preserve: ActionMenu, StoryPanel, HeaderOverlay and ContributionSheet behavior
PhaserHost mount-once lifecycle and resize/DPR handling
useGame persistence and the shared gameStore

technical_constraints: Phaser 3.90, React, TypeScript, Zustand as already configured in game/frontend
Phaser owns rendering; React must not draw the scene with div or img elements
Tests must mock createGame/phaser and never start a real Phaser game
definition_of_done: App mounts PhaserHost with BootScene in place of SceneView
objectClick from the bus selects the object in App
New and updated unit tests pass with Phaser mocked
non_functional: No duplicate Phaser instances, including under React StrictMode
